payload.title: Close and measure Frank Harness repository-truth-gate bypass on Ubuntu
payload.work_clay: Re-read newest gschaidergabriel/frankv0.1 main plus draft PR #25. Independently reproduce the finding that harness/frank_harness_runtime.py reaches open_pair() without the repository/materialization truth preflight used by frank_prompt_capsule.py. If reproduced, integrate fail-closed repo_truth_gate enforcement at the canonical Harness entry boundary so every repository-backed Harness read/mutation path is blocked unless status=PASS; retain self-test isolation. Exercise PASS plus MATERIALIZATION_STALE, GRAPH_STALE, SCHEMA_MIGRATION_REQUIRED and CONTINUITY_DEGRADED fault injections and prove zero canonical Harness mutation after every rejected preflight. Run existing Harness/state regressions. On the Ubuntu v0.1 target, measure cold/warm preflight latency, git-fetch contribution, SQLite-open latency, guarded Harness command latency and recovery after induced stale/divergent materialization. Separately probe trusted_schema=OFF and SQLITE_DBCONFIG_DEFENSIVE compatibility as a research experiment; do not promote that hardening without a passing compatibility receipt.
payload.reason_clay: Current Frank prompt injection already fails closed through runtime/state/repo_truth_gate.py, which verifies repository head, critical files, UnifiedDB lineage and ClayGraph source epoch. The legacy Harness controller instead calls open_pair() directly. The initial broader hypothesis that Frank lacks pair-coherence validation was therefore refuted; the narrower entry-path bypass remains code-supported. SQLite official documentation also confirms that multi-database atomicity is not guaranteed under WAL, making fail-closed lineage validation a material correctness boundary rather than cosmetic duplication.
payload.completion_clay: Ubuntu execution receipt proves the bypass either reproduced or falsified. If reproduced: all repository-backed Harness entry paths require repo truth PASS; stale/graph-stale/migration/degraded injections produce expected exit classes and zero canonical DB mutations; existing self-tests/regressions pass; PASS path executes; cold/warm latency distributions and failure/recovery timings are recorded; PR #25 is revised or superseded by the smallest verified integration; any trusted_schema/DEFENSIVE proposal has an explicit compatibility verdict. No H1/BASE gate is credited from this safety task alone.
payload.executor_policy: Use the local Claude Code/build-execution organ or another actually connected Ubuntu execution surface with repository checkout. A connector read, ChatGPT sandbox test, GitHub branch, PR or CI proxy is not an Ubuntu developer-host receipt. Re-read remote main immediately before patching; preserve Frank/Clay authority separation; use reversible branch/PR workflow and append-only receipts; never mark PASS from proposed code alone.
invalidators: newer Frank main already removes the direct Harness bypass with verified Ubuntu evidence
project owner supersedes Ubuntu developer system as v0.1 target
